Market today: Treasury yields are falling, which usually helps growth stocks, but the real driver is AI debt worries and Big Tech spending squeezes. This is hitting your concentrated tech/chip book hard.

Your holdings: SMCI (-48.45%), SOXL (-85.49%), and MUU (-72.09%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on Nvidia's rebound and how it masks broader tech spending issues. Also, watch the semiconductor ETF SMH, which is down significantly.

Bottom line: Your concentrated tech book is facing headwinds; focus on managing risk in your leveraged positions.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's down nearly 50% and the AI spending squeeze is a concern.
Consider trimming SOXL: Down over 85%, the leveraged decay is brutal. Respect the stop.
No new buys today - hold and watch
